sn18.10:1.3: Rūpam niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn18.10:1.8: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn18.10:1.10: Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi nibbindati || saṅkhāresu pi nibbindati || viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || || 8
sn18.10:1.11: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn18.10:1.12: Khīṇā jāti || vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ || kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
